gestational-self-determination-is-the-de.note: Cold-graded on merit before any cross-wing scale-check; axes committed on the written prose, bands derived from the UNROUNDED geomean. long geomean 0.881765 (rsi 88.2) -> A, clear of the boundary band (0.88 + 0.0018); medium geomean 0.865099 (rsi 86.5/B); short geomean 0.843369 (rsi 84.3/B). No flagged boundary cell at any depth. Axis reasoning. v=0.90: the burden-inversion is valid and the bodily non-conscriptability core (a right to life is not a right to use an unwilling other's body) is a clean, decisive engine; held at 0.90 rather than 0.91/0.92 because the spine is a default-SETTER that ROUTES its three hardest contests (personhood-as-trump, causal-responsibility, withdrawing-vs-killing) rather than closing them in-node — valid as a burden-placement, not offered as a complete defeat. s=0.88: the non-conscriptability premise is rock-solid (settled law and common morality forbid compelled organ/marrow/blood donation even to save a life); the single A-club contestable joint is the FIT of the bodily-donation analogy to gestation (the natural-dependency and disanalogy pressures), which the spine meets via the general principle and routes at its sharpest rather than conceding. c=0.86: complete AS A DEFAULT-SETTER — it fixes the default, motivates it, grants personhood arguendo to show the default survives, and accounts for the override-attempts by naming and routing them; tempered to 0.86 (the H1-style deferral penalty, slightly heavier) because it defers three genuinely weighty contests to as-yet-unbuilt nodes (the foundation node and two Layer-1 nodes), so a reader of the spine alone is left with the hardest questions explicitly routed-but-open. r=0.86: the burden-inversion is robust, and the turn that every override-attempt CONCEDES the default (an objection that must work to place the burden on the chooser has granted it does not start there) is a strong robustness anchor; held at 0.86 because three weighty contests remain genuinely open and routed, so a peer pressing any one finds the spine has deferred rather than defeated — heavier routed weight than the Transgenderism spine carried. a=0.91: a clean optionality/autonomy register — appraisal-silent, asymmetry-independent, importing no antinatalist consideration, the right standing for a pregnant person who rejects antinatalism outright, competent-adult bracket stated; held at 0.91 (with the Transgenderism spine and the K169/H4 cluster) rather than 0.92 because the case forces the spine to engage the second party's standing (granting personhood arguendo to route it), one step from the purely self-regarding autonomy that earns 0.92. L137 precondition gates verified in the prose: Layer-1 tag; Firewall-A seal (no exhortation); quarantine seal (asymmetry-independent, zero antinatalism in-node); G1 distinctness vs the other wings (the bodily/gestational-sovereignty / non-conscriptability machinery, which a Transgenderism or RTD optionality node does not carry); competent-adult bracket stated; personhood granted arguendo and ROUTED to the foundation node, never settled in-spine. prose_md5 binds the grade to the exact rebuttal bytes read back from the written node file. Cross-wing scale-check (long unrounded, AFTER the cold grade): the abortion spine 0.881765 sits essentially co-located with the Transgenderism spine (0.881254/A) — honest structural kinship, since both are burden-inversion default-setters opening their wings; the abortion spine's stronger Thomson-style core is offset by its heavier routed weight from the genuine second party. It lands just above uncertainty (0.880597/A) and the Transgenderism spine (0.881254/A) and just below distress (0.881855/A); above the B siblings regret (0.879704) and bystander (0.879728); below permission (0.885852/A), the K169/H4 pair (0.889843/A), origin (0.891790/A), limiting (0.895808/A), and preservation (0.897834/A). A wing-opening spine sitting in the low-A band is the honest place for a node that does this much routing; the tuple was committed before comparison, not score-targeted.
